'''Ian Bryan Olivera de Oliveira''' (born 5 October 2004) is an Andorran [[association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[centre back]] for Spanish [[Segunda Federación]] club [[Getafe CF B|Getafe CF B]] and the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]].

==Club career==
Born in [[Andorra la Vella]], Olivera played in the youth teams of Spanish clubs CA Segre,<ref name=heraldo>{{cite news |title=La UD Barbastro se refuerza con un futbolista internacional|trans-title=UD Barbastro strengthen themselves with an international footballer |url=https://www.heraldo.es/noticias/deportes/futbol/2025/01/22/la-ud-barbastro-se-refuerza-con-un-futbolista-internacional-1793836.html |access-date=29 September 2025 |work=[[Heraldo de Aragón]] |date=22 January 2025 |language=Spanish}}</ref> [[Lleida CF]] and Racing Club Zaragoza.<!--Not professional club Real Zaragoza--><ref name=basco/> In 2023, he joined [[CF Calamocha]] of the fifth-tier [[Tercera Federación]], also in [[Aragon]].<ref name=basco>{{cite news |last1=Basco |first1=Marc |title=La selecció tanca el preeuropeu amb una sensació agredolça|trans-title=National team conclude European qualifiers with a bittersweet feeling |url=https://www.diariandorra.ad/esports/231123/la-seleccio-tanca-preeuropeu-amb-una-sensacio-agredolca_132949.html |access-date=29 September 2025 |work=[[Diari d'Andorra]] |date=23 November 2023 |language=Catalan}}</ref>

In August 2024, after having played for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] against [[Spain national football team|Spain]] in a [[Exhibition game|friendly]] before [[UEFA Euro 2024]], Olivera went on trial at [[Salamanca CF UDS]] in the [[Segunda Federación]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Cuervo |first1=Carlos |title=Ian Olivera, a prueba con el Salamanca UDS tras jugar contra España previo a la Eurocopa 2024|trans-title=Ian Olivera, on trial with Salamanca UDS after playing against Spain ahead of Euro 2024 |url=https://salamancartvaldia.es/noticia/2024-08-06-ian-olivera-a-prueba-con-el-salamanca-uds-tras-jugar-contra-espana-previo-a-la-eurocopa-2024-352186 |access-date=29 September 2025 |publisher=Salamanca al Día |date=6 August 2024 |language=Spanish}}</ref> The 19-year-old was then signed to the first team.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Pacho |first1=Manel |title=Ian Olivera se queda en el Salamanca UDS|trans-title=Ian Olivera is staying at Salamanca UDS|url=https://www.tribunasalamanca.com/noticias/377616/ian-olivera-se-queda-en-el-salamanca-uds |access-date=29 September 2025 |work=Tribuna Salamanca |date=28 August 2024 |language=Spanish}}</ref> He made his debut on 26 October at home to [[CD Laredo]], entering as a [[Substitute (association football)|substitute]] for the last nine minutes and heading in a free kick to conclude a 5–1 win.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Pacho |first1=Manel |title=El Salamanca UDS regala la primera victoria a su gente con una manita al Laredo|trans-title=Salamanca UDS gift a first victory to their fans by hitting Laredo for five |url=https://www.tribunasalamanca.com/noticias/383524/el-salamanca-uds-regala-la-primera-victoria-a-su-gente-con-una-manita-al-laredo |access-date=29 September 2025 |work=Tribuna Salamanca |date=26 October 2024 |language=Spanish}}</ref>

On 22 January 2025, having recorded only 123 minutes of play in three games for Salamanca, Olivera was loaned to [[UD Barbastro]] in the same league.<ref name=heraldo/> He played 14 times, including both legs of their successful playoff against relegation, and scored the last-minute only goal of the victory over [[CD Anguiano]] on 23 February.<ref>{{cite news |title=Ian Olivera puso la guinda en el día de la cantera|trans-title=Ian Olivera put the cherry on top of the academy day|url=https://www.elcruzado.es/ian-olivera-puso-la-guinda-en-el-dia-de-la-cantera/ |access-date=29 September 2025 |work=El Cruzado Aragonés |date=23 February 2025 |language=Spanish}}</ref>

Olivera signed for [[CD Numancia]], again in the fourth tier, on 1 August 2025. He joined on a one-year deal, and took an under-23 quota place.<ref>{{cite news |title=El Numancia cierra su retaguardia con la incorporación del internacional Ian Olivera|trans-title=Numancia complete their back line with the signing of international Ian Olivera |url=https://sorianoticias.com/noticia/2025-08-01-el-numancia-cierra-su-retaguardia-con-la-incorporacion-del-internacional-ian-olivera-123410 |access-date=29 September 2025 |publisher=Soria Noticias |date=1 August 2025 |language=Spanish}}</ref> Following a [[2026 Segunda Federación play-offs|playoff elimination]], he joined [[Getafe CF B]] in the same league.<ref>{{cite news |title=Ian Olivera s’incorpora al Getafe B i continuarà a 2a RFEF després de caure al play-off d’ascens amb el Numància|trans-title=Ian Olivera joins Getafe B and will continue in Segunda Federación after falling in promotion playoffs with Numancia|url=https://elperiodic.ad/esports/ian-olivera-sincorpora-al-getafe-b-i-continuara-a-2a-rfef-despres-de-caure-al-play-off-dascens-amb-el-numancia|access-date=20 July 2026|work=[[El Periòdic d'Andorra]] |date=17 July 2026 |language=Catalan}}</ref>

==International career==
Olivera debuted for the [[Andorra national under-19 football team|Andorra under-19 team]] at age 17 in 2021, playing European qualifiers.<ref name=basco/> Two years later he was called up for the [[Andorra national under-21 football team|under-21 team]], playing every minute of their six games of 2021.<ref name=basco/>

On 21 November 2023, a month after turning 19, Olivera made his senior debut in a 2–0 home loss to [[Israel national football team|Israel]] at the end of [[UEFA Euro 2024 qualifying]].<ref name=basco/>

Olivera played in a 1–0 home loss to [[England men's national football team|England]] at the [[RCDE Stadium]] near [[Barcelona]], in [[2026 FIFA World Cup]] [[2026 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)|qualification]]. Wearing only his first name on his shirt, he was serenaded by the England fans, who sang "Stand up if you love Ian" and "Follow Ian away".<ref>{{cite news |last1=Wilson |first1=Jonathan |title=England were dismal against minnows Andorra but it really doesn’t matter |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2025/jun/07/england-andorra-thomas-tuchel-world-cup-qualifier-football |access-date=29 September 2025 |work=[[The Guardian]] |date=7 June 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=(vídeos) ‘Stand up if you love Ian’ o ‘Follow Ian anyway’ [''sic'']: fans anglesos canten a un futbolista andorrà|trans-title=(videos) 'Stand up if you love Ian' or 'Follow Ian away': English fans sing to an Andorran footballer|url=https://digitalandorra.com/tendencies/videos-stand-up-if-you-love-ian-o-follow-ian-aniway-fans-anglesos-canten-a-un-futbolista-andorra/ |access-date=29 September 2025 |publisher=Digital Andorra |date=10 June 2025 |language=Catalan}}</ref> In another qualifier on 11 October, he headed his first international goal in a 2–2 draw away to [[Latvia national football team|Latvia]].<ref name=goal>{{cite news |last1=Basco |first1=Marc |title=La selecció suma un gran punt a Letònia (2-2)|trans-title=National team add a big point away to Latvia (2-2) |url=https://www.diariandorra.ad/esports/251012/seleccio-suma-gran-punt-letonia-2-2_181828.html |access-date=13 October 2025 |work=[[Diari d'Andorra]] |date=12 October 2025 |language=Catalan}}</ref>
